name: TEACh
description: TEACh is a dataset of over 3,000 human-human interactive dialogues designed to study embodied agents that perform household tasks via natural language interaction. It supports benchmarks for dialogue understanding, language grounding, and task execution in simulated environments.
reputation: A well-known embodied AI benchmark for interactive household task completion in simulated environments, frequently used for dialogue-grounded agent research.
notes: Focuses on natural language interaction for embodied agents in household tasks; includes three benchmarks for dialogue, grounding, and execution.
